questions.q: What happens again and again in Judges?
questions.a: Israel sins, is oppressed, cries out, and God raises a judge

questions.q: The last verse of Judges — complete it.
questions.text: In those days there was no [king] in Israel: every man did that which was right in his own [eyes].

questions.a: Dew on the fleece only, then on the ground only

questions.q: With how many men did God save Israel from Midian through Gideon?

questions.a: Lest Israel boast that their own hand saved them

questions.a: His hair had never been cut

questions.a: He pulled down the house of Dagon on the Philistines
